# Browser font fixture

`playfair-display-latin-variable.woff2` is the unmodified Latin normal variable font from `@fontsource-variable/playfair-display@5.3.0`, file `files/playfair-display-latin-wght-normal.woff2`.

- Source package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fontsource-variable/playfair-display/v/5.3.0
- SHA-256: `e0c764a8e9e1cce92163c55bac4b2ad6cd4cf8c696ce2289ab5c41565e65b7e2`
- License: `OFL-playfair-display.txt` (SIL Open Font License 1.1).

The fixture makes font loading, preview updates, exports and screenshot tests deterministic and independent of Google's network availability. It is test data, not a production font catalog.
